meta.siteDescription: Solve algorithm and math problems with instant automated judging. Python, C++ and Go are supported.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.metaDescription: Sign in through the Telegram bot in seconds — no password needed.
auth.lead: No password. The Telegram bot gives you a one-time code.
auth.step2: The bot replies with a 6-digit code
auth.invalidCode: The code is wrong or has expired. Get a new one from the bot.
auth.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please try again in a few minutes.
auth.offline: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
auth.genericError: Could not sign in. Please try again.
auth.expiryNote: The code is valid for 2 minutes.

home.title: Write code, see the result instantly
home.subtitle: Algorithm and math problems. Your solution is judged automatically — in Python, C++ or Go.

problems.title: Problems
problems.metaDescription: A collection of algorithm and math problems. Each one has time and memory limits, sample tests and instant judging.

submission.title: Submit solution
submission.loginRequired: Sign in to submit a solution.
submission.tooManyPending: Too many of your solutions are waiting to be judged. Please wait a moment.
submission.genericError: Could not submit the solution. Please try again.
submission.offline: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
submission.stillJudging: Judging is taking longer than usual. You can check the result later.
submission.historyEmpty: You have not submitted a solution to this problem yet.
submission.noSampleTests: This problem has no sample tests — try it with your own input.
submission.runHint: Runs on the sample tests. The result is not saved to your history.
submission.inputTooLarge: The input is too large (16 KB max).

error.title: Something went wrong
error.hint: The page could not be loaded. Try again — if the problem persists, come back a little later.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.hint: The address may have changed, or the problem is not published yet.
